Laura / Monica —

Posting my numbers — Overall 3/5
- Coding: 3 — correct approach, but I had to prompt twice on complexity and edge cases
- System design: 2 — high-level ok, but missed caching/kv-cache considerations that are critical for our runtime. Concerned about assumptions on statefulness
- Cultural fit: 4 — great collaborator
- Communication: 3 — concise but skipped verification questions initially

Gating concern: maybe. The system design gaps would be risky for a mid-level role that will own latency-sensitive components. I'd prefer a short follow-up loop focused on state management and cache coherency, or a take-home design exercise.

Quoting my candidate notes below for context:
> Candidate suggested sharded in-memory cache without describing invalidation strategy; when asked about races he suggested optimistic locking but couldn't articulate metrics to detect regressions.

I'll attach my scorecard. If we want to move forward without another loop, I'd look for pairing with a senior for the first 2 months to mitigate risk.

—Vivek
